_doc: Regexes are tried in order per bank, then a generic fallback. Named groups: amount, type, last4, merchant, ref, balance, limit, date. Macros: {AMT} amount, {CUR} Rs/INR/₹, {MASK} XX/** mask, {DATE} date token. Body whitespace (including new lines) is collapsed to single spaces before matching. Matching is case-insensitive.
